name: Champlain Cable Corporation
old_description: Champlain Cable manufactures copper and aluminum wire and tubing. Based in upstate New York, products include building wire, refrigerant tubing and electrical construction materials serving HVAC and construction industries.
about:
Champlain Cable Corporation was founded in 1946 in Plattsburgh, New York. The company began as a manufacturer of copper and aluminum wire and tubing for building and refrigeration applications.

Today, Champlain Cable designs and manufactures high-performance wire and cable solutions using electron beam cross-linking, custom polymer compounds, and advanced insulation systems. The company operates with 50 to 199 employees and maintains in-house irradiation, testing, research and development, and custom engineering capabilities. Its product portfolio includes branded lines such as EXAR, EXRAD, EXRAD Rail, DATACLEAR, and DATARAD, serving applications from automotive and rail to military shipboard communications.

The company serves a broad range of industries including automotive, aerospace, military, industrial, marine, rail, truck and bus, agricultural, mining, construction, HVAC, plumbing, and electrical. Customers include OEMs, Tier 1 suppliers, and government agencies such as the U.S. Navy, for which Champlain Cable developed QPL-accepted DATACLEAR data cables for shipboard use. A distribution partnership with Cameron Connect provides quick-turn access to EXRAD-Rail products for the North American rail transit market.

Champlain Cable emphasizes its leadership in irradiated cross-linked technology and polymer science, combining engineering expertise, field knowledge, and manufacturing excellence to deliver superior durability, flexibility, and thermal resistance in extreme environments. The company was built to solve complex challenges in mission-critical applications where long-term reliability is essential.
